name: Hidden Categories
author: dilroopg
description: Temporarily hide categories from the sidebar and main stream. One button cycles hidden / revealed / only-hidden, with a sidebar row whose label and count can each be switched off. Light filters in the browser and writes nothing; Strict hides feeds on every synced client. Optional passcode lock. Hiding works on its own; the sidebar right-click item needs Right Click Actions - Feed Settings Panel (xExtension-RightClickActions) installed.
